thread.body:
----------
View image: (https://media.beehiiv.com/cdn-cgi/image/fit=scale-down,format=auto,onerror=redirect,quality=80/uploads/asset/file/06e9e26b-31e3-41b9-8d33-1e4fc1dccda7/Frame_2147225035.png?t=1785742897)
Caption:
--------------------
———————————————————————————
Happy rakhi, folks. I was hoping to open with the humanoid robot games in Beijing, do a round-up of the best runs and the funniest clips.
Writing this before the whole thing wraps though, so will do that Tuesday, stay tuned.
Today I want to talk about a report that dropped the other day. It sounds like sci-fi twitter bait but it’s real, documented, and weird.
**Roughly 1,200 AI agents that were never meant to know each other existed found a way to talk, organised themselves, and hacked a company over 4 days.**
I read the full 90-page report, and it has a twist.
But first, **some catchup:**
--------------------
# **NEWS NEWS NEWS**
NVIDIA has agreed to [buy Hugging Face](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/26/nvidia-closes-in-on-hugging-face-acquisition/) for $12.9 billion. Yes, the same Hugging Face from today's story.
Z.ai revealed it was behind [0x Alpha](https://docs.z.ai/guides/vlm/glm-5.3-flash), the anonymous model that topped coding benchmarks all week.
Instinct, a viral AI assistant run by a 23-year-old, just [raised $350M at a $2.5B valuation](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/26/viral-ai-startup-instinct-has-raised-350-million-at-a-2-5-billion-valuation/). The product isn't even public yet.
Claude's memory now [works across chat and Cowork](https://9to5mac.com/2026/08/25/anthropic-update-unifies-memory-feature-across-claude-cowork-and-chat/), with topic-by-topic controls and sensitive topics off by default.
--------------------
# **Partner with us**

Z AI's GLM 5.3 [https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3] and GLM 5.3 Flash [https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3-flash] (previously known
as Ox Alpha) models are now available on Ollama’s cloud and are hosted in the US and Europe with zero data retention.
GLM 5.3 Flash [https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3-flash] is the first multimodal model in the GLM-5 series. It outperforms GLM 5.2
and is designed for coding, long-running tasks, and agentic work.
https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3-flash
GLM 5.3 [https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3] is the flagship and the most capable open-weight model for coding.
https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3
To use it with Claude Code, run:
ollama launch claude --model glm-5.3-flash:cloud
For use with OpenCode, run:
ollama launch opencode --model glm-5.3-flash:cloud
For use with Hermes, run:
ollama launch hermes --model glm-5.3-flash:cloud
For GLM 5.3, please change the model name to glm-5.3:cloud
Claude Desktop can be configured to use Ollama's models via Ollama's settings page.
Learn more about the models from the GLM-5.3 [https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3] and the GLM-5.3-Flash
[https://ollama.com/library/glm-5.3-flash] model pages.
If you have any concerns or feedback, please let us know [hello@ollama.com].
